text:
The plate holds two small cross-sections of corn on the cob, each about 4 cm across and 2-3 cm thick. Each piece probably weighs 35-45 g including the cob, so the two together are about 80 g. Corn kernels run about 86-96 kcal per 100 g, but the cob adds mass without adding calories. Counting the edible portion only, the total comes to about 70 kcal.

{"kcal": 70, "mass_g": 80}
